name: Asian Alliance International Public Company Limited
summary: Asian Alliance International Public Company Limited, a Thai enterprise, specializes in the manufacture and sale of both pet nourishment and convenient human food items. Its pet food range caters to dogs and cats, encompassing various wet formulations like savory soups, delicate salads, fish and meat preparations, mousses, and pates, alongside dry kibble options. Additionally, the company provides packaged, ready-to-consume human meals featuring ingredients such as tuna, salmon, tilapia, sea bass, mackerel, and shrimp. Established in 2005, the firm's operations are headquartered in Mueang Samut Sakhon, Thailand.
